backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing comment list management, bulk generation with access key validation, rating images, user profiles, wallet balances, payment records, password storage, session tokens, device-scoped comment history, app events, and admin access control with non-auth access code (5676).
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that preserves the nonAuthAccessCode field during canister upgrades by returning the old state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: individual delete buttons for comments and usernames, clear all functionality, one-click data export in CSV/JSON formats, and local storage caching for instant data display.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including main app structure with tabbed navigation, React Query hooks for backend operations, admin panel with five tabs, optimized animated background, and various UI components with gradient styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with pre-React error handler to display fallback UI on fatal errors, browser shim for process.env, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with four-tab navigation (Customer View, Upload Section, Live List, Admin Panel), session-based admin unlock state, midnight comment list clearing, music player initialization, and theme provider wrapping.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Presentational component displaying an access denied message with shield icon and destructive alert when unauthorized users attempt to access the Admin Panel.
A dialog component that prompts users to enter an access key for bulk comment generation, with password input, loading state, and submit/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/AdminChatPanel.t: An admin panel component for viewing and replying to user messages, displaying message threads with timestamps, unread counts, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminDetailsCard: A card component displaying static admin information including name (Nishant Chaudhary), contact number, progression status, and payment timing.
frontend/src/components/AdminMusicManage: An admin component for uploading and managing background music files (MP3/WAV), with file validation, upload progress tracking, and preview functionality.
frontend/src/components/AdminPinDialog.t: A dialog component that validates a 4-digit admin access code against ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE constant, with error handling and validation feedback.
frontend/src/components/AdminUserImageTa: An admin component for bulk uploading user rating images with progress tracking, displaying all user images in a table, and supporting download/delete operations per user.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackgrou: Renders an animated canvas background with floating particles and geometric shapes (circles, squares, triangles) that move, rotate, and change colors with hue cycling. Includes performance optimizations like FPS throttling, visibility detection, and reduced motion support.
frontend/src/components/BulkGeneratorKey: Provides a UI for managing the bulk comment generator access key, allowing admins to view the current masked key, set a new key, or reset it. Uses React Query hooks for API interactions and includes confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
frontend/src/components/ChatBox.tsx: A placeholder component that returns null, indicating it is no longer used in admin-only mode.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches unhandled errors in the component tree and displays a user-friendly error screen with options to reload the page or try again.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays a footer with copyright information and a branded link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters based on the current hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with branding, theme toggle (light/dark mode), music controls, admin unlock status badge, and logout button. Includes sticky positioning and backdrop blur styling.
frontend/src/components/Interactive3DCub: Renders an interactive 3D cube using React Three Fiber that continuously rotates, responds to mouse movement, changes color on hover, and displays edge highlights with gradient lighting effects.
frontend/src/components/MusicControls.ts: Music player controls component with play/pause toggle and volume slider in a popover, using a custom useMusicPlayer hook for state management.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooterGa: Canvas-based top-down shooter game where players control a character with WASD/arrow keys, shoot projectiles at enemies with mouse clicks, and track score with localStorage-persisted high scores. Includes game state management, collision detection, and enemy spawning logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and initializing access control with an admin token from URL parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLiveListQueri: Provides React Query hooks for admin operations on app events (create, delete, add/remove usernames, reset) with local storage caching and toast notifications using a hardcoded admin access code.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: React hook that returns a stable device identifier persisted in localStorage, memoized to prevent recalculation across renders.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedGenera: Mutation hook for generating a single comment scoped to a device ID, updating both backend state and localStorage mirror while invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedUserCo: Query hooks to check if a device has generated a comment for a list and fetch device-scoped comment history, syncing backend data with localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and provider component, managing login/logout state and identity persistence with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListQueries.ts: Query and mutation hooks for fetching app event IDs and checking if usernames exist in specific app events.
frontend/src/hooks/useMidnightCommentLis: Effect hook that automatically clears comment lists at midnight (00:00-00:59) once per day, tracking last clear date in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.ts: Manages background music playback with HTML5 Audio API, including play/pause, volume control, autoplay handling, and state persistence in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasswordAuth.tsx: File appears to be empty or truncated in the provided content.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for managing comment lists, including CRUD operations, locking/unlocking, bulk operations, rating images, messages, and admin functions like clearing all data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, gradient utilities, animations (fade-slide-in, pulse-glow), and design tokens for colors, borders, and shadows.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/account/ProfilePage.t: Displays user profile information (name, email, phone, UPI) read from localStorage. Shows account details in styled cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLiveListPanel.ts: Admin panel for managing app/event live lists with functionality to create events, add/remove usernames, reset lists, and delete events using confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Main admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing comment lists, chat, user images, bulk generator keys, live lists, and music, including bulk operations and data export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignInPage.tsx: Empty file for sign-in page component.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignUpPage.tsx: Empty file for sign-up page component.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListChecker.tsx: User-facing page that allows checking if usernames exist across multiple selected app/event lists, displaying results with found/not-found status badges.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentsPage: Displays payment transaction history with status badges (approved/rejected/pending). Currently shows mock empty state with scrollable transaction list UI.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSection.tsx: Upload section component for bulk comment generation and rating image uploads. Handles file selection with preview, access key validation, and provides UI for generating multiple comments at once with copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UserView.tsx: Customer-facing view that allows single comment generation per device per list and includes a top-down shooter mini-game. Enforces device-scoped generation limits and displays locked list status.
frontend/src/pages/wallet/WalletPage.tsx: Shows user wallet balance (currently mock zero balance) with styled cards and information about wallet usage.
frontend/src/utils/adminPinSession.ts: Exports the hardcoded admin access code constant '5676' for backend compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/dataExport.ts: Utility for exporting all backend data (comments, app events, messages) to CSV and JSON formats with proper escaping and timestamp formatting.
Provides localStorage utilities for managing device-scoped comment history, with functions to load, save, update, and clear history records keyed by device ID.
frontend/src/utils/deviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device identifier in localStorage using crypto.randomUUID or fallback methods, independent of user authentication.
frontend/src/utils/localStorageCache.ts: Implements versioned localStorage caching for AppEvents with 5-minute TTL, providing save, load, and clear functions with automatic expiration handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and parameter cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (HSL-based design tokens), border radius variables, custom animations (pulse-glow), and typography plugin.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing an app review and comment management website with admin controls, music system, shooter game, and features including delete buttons, data export, caching, and music management.
